title: Evaluate list view types spec compliance and update ROADMAP_SPEC.md
body:
Audited all 7 list view types (grid, kanban, calendar, gantt, timeline, map, gallery) against `@objectstack/spec v3.0.0` ListViewSchema. Found systematic gaps in navigation property support, missing config type definitions, and unimplemented spec properties.

### Navigation property coverage

| Property | Grid | Kanban | Calendar | Gantt | Timeline | Map | Gallery |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `mode` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| `width` | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| `view` | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

ObjectGallery has zero navigation support — only accepts `onCardClick`.

### Critical type gaps

- **TimelineConfig** — not defined in `@object-ui/types`; plugin uses `dateField` instead of spec's `startDateField`; missing `endDateField`, `groupByField`, `colorField`, `scale`
- **GalleryConfig** — implemented but not exported from types `index.ts`
- **ListViewSchema** — 10+ spec properties unimplemented: `quickFilters`, `hiddenFields`, `fieldOrder`, `virtualScroll`, `conditionalFormatting`, `inlineEdit`, `exportOptions`, `emptyState`, `aria`, `rowHeight`

### ROADMAP_SPEC.md updates

- **Sections 3.3, 3.7, 3.8, 4.1–4.4** — Downgraded Spec UI Compliance ratings where gaps exist; documented specific missing properties
- **Section 6.1** — Added per-view-type navigation matrix and config schema compliance table
- **Section 6.3** — Updated View Enhancements row with TimelineConfigSchema gap
- **Section 6.4** — Added 5 new critical gaps (#11–#15)
- **Section 7** — Added 12 improvement tasks (#64–#76) across P1/P2/P3
